name: eth_notional_multiplier_capped_remeasure_20260808
created: 2026-08-08, written BEFORE any capped multiplier number was computed
question: Under the ACTUAL live portfolio configuration (total_notional_cap=3.0, shares eth50/btc30/sol20, duration gate OFF), does FINAL_GOVERNOR_OMEGA4_6_1_ETH_NOTIONAL_MULTIPLIER=1.5 still have any support, or should it revert to the 1.0x default?

framing_that_sets_the_burden_of_proof.this_is_not_a_selection: 1.0x is the DEFAULT — it means 'use the notional the risk sidecar itself computed'. 1.5x is an ACTIVE INTERVENTION layered on top of a model that already calibrated its own margin_fraction/leverage (a risk the 07-12 baseline doc itself flagged in writing). Removing an unsupported intervention is not the same act as adopting a new tuned value.
framing_that_sets_the_burden_of_proof.consequence: No fresh window is required to REVERT, because reverting fits nothing. A fresh window would be required to ADOPT some other multiplier — and this contract forbids adopting any value other than 1.0x or 1.5x.
framing_that_sets_the_burden_of_proof.grid_is_frozen: The multiplier grid is exactly the 07-12 grid [1.0, 1.25, 1.5, 1.75, 2.0, 2.5, 3.0]. Reported in full for shape, but ONLY 1.0x and 1.5x are decidable outcomes. Picking 1.25x because it scores well would be post-hoc selection and is explicitly forbidden.

prior_evidence_stated_up_front.why_1.5x_was_chosen_20260712: docs/model_contracts/portfolio_concurrent_3asset_CURRENT_BASELINE_20260712.md: chosen (not the PnL-maximising 3.0x) because it was 'the point where OOS improves meaningfully over 1.0x', with validation sign-inversion above ~2.0-2.5x as the ceiling constraint. Note this makes 1.5x an OOS-SELECTED value; validation monotonically preferred 1.0x even then.
prior_evidence_stated_up_front.uncapped_recheck_20260808: scripts/rerun_portfolio_sweep_current_data_20260808.py, tmp/portfolio_sweep_recheck_20260808/report.json. On current data, UNCAPPED, gate off, 1.0x strictly dominates 1.5x on ALL THREE splits and BOTH axes: validation +28.28/−30.94 vs +22.90/−36.71; oos_extended +102.84/−31.20 vs +64.66/−37.82; oos_frozen_q1_2026 +151.72/−22.34 vs +113.47/−37.10. The stated reason for choosing 1.5x (OOS improves over 1.0x) is therefore REFUTED uncapped, and the 07-12 'PnL rises monotonically with the multiplier' claim does not reproduce (now non-monotone: dips at 1.5-2.0, jumps at 2.5).
prior_evidence_stated_up_front.what_is_still_unknown_and_is_why_this_co: That recheck ran UNCAPPED, but live runs total_notional_cap=3.0. `asset_notional_multipliers` is applied unconditionally BEFORE cap_mode, so a binding cap attenuates the multiplier — possibly to the point where 1.0x and 1.5x converge. The uncapped result cannot be transferred to live.
prior_evidence_stated_up_front.companion_result_that_does_reproduce: The duration-gate stress test at the live reference config DID reproduce: gate_off strictly dominates gate_on on both OOS splits. The live gate-off setting is verified and is NOT in question here.

window_honesty.validation_2025Q4: Reproduces the 07-12 numbers to the decimal (1.0x +28.28, 2.0x +12.17, 2.5x −2.39, 3.0x −18.98), i.e. 2025Q4 data has settled and is unrevised. It was used in 2026-07-12 as a CONSTRAINT (the sign-inversion ceiling), not as the selector. Usable here as supporting evidence, not as sole proof.
window_honesty.oos_extended_2026H1: CONTAMINATED — this is the window that SELECTED 1.5x in the first place, and it has been read repeatedly on 2026-08-08. It cannot select anything here. It can only fail to support the incumbent.
window_honesty.oos_frozen_q1_2026: Subset of oos_extended; NOT independent. Reported, never counted as a second window.
window_honesty.mitigation: Because the only decidable outcomes are 'keep the intervention' or 'remove it', contamination cuts in the safe direction: a contaminated window that still fails to support 1.5x is strong evidence against it, since that window is the one biased in its favour.

declared_gaps_between_this_replay_and_li: The portfolio replay does NOT model FINAL_GOVERNOR_OMEGA4_6_1_ETH_CHOP_SOFT_SIZE_ENABLE=True (grep: no chop handling in replay_portfolio_concurrent_3asset_native_20260712.py or replay_portfolio_rl_gate_2action_native_20260708.py). Live applies an additional chop-conditional size reduction this test cannot see.

Live applies the multiplier inside trading_bot.py at decision time (trading_bot.py:9224) and the cap at trading_bot.py:11412; the replay applies both in its own engine. Parity between the two has not been re-verified today.
Costs/slippage follow the replay's model, not live fills.
Therefore this test answers 'is 1.5x supported under a binding cap in the replay', NOT 'what will live earn'.

G0_regression_HALT.rule: re-running the UNCAPPED multiplier grid inside the same script must reproduce today's uncapped numbers for 1.0x and 1.5x on all three splits to within 0.05pp on PnL and MDD
G0_regression_HALT.on_fail: HALT. A harness that cannot reproduce the uncapped run cannot be trusted for the capped one.

G1_capped_dominance.rule: Under cap=3.0, compare 1.0x vs 1.5x on all three splits and both axes (PnL, MDD).
G1_capped_dominance.retain_1.5x_only_if: 1.5x beats 1.0x on PnL in at least 2 of 3 splits AND worsens MDD by no more than 2.0pp on every split
G1_capped_dominance.rationale: burden is on the intervention, per the framing above

G2_convergence_check.rule: report |PnL(1.5x) − PnL(1.0x)| under the cap versus the same quantity uncapped
G2_convergence_check.purpose: quantifies how much the cap attenuates the multiplier. If the gap collapses toward zero, the honest conclusion is 'the flag barely matters under the live cap', which is a different (and weaker) statement than 'revert because 1.0x is better'. This distinction must be stated in the verdict.

G3_effect_size.instrument_note: A per-trade Welch t between 1.0x and 1.5x is DEGENERATE when the cap is not binding, because the multiplier is a deterministic scale on the same trades — the same trap as the multislot variance ratio 0.104 on 2026-08-08. The operative instruments are therefore: (a) MONTHLY paired differences with a sign test, (b) dominance across all three splits on both axes, (c) the risk channel (MDD) reported explicitly rather than inferred. min_abs_t is applied to the monthly difference series, not to per-trade returns, and this substitution is declared here rather than discovered later.

G4_outcome_ceiling.rule: This contract may RECOMMEND reverting the .env flag to 1.0x. It may NOT change any live configuration. The .env edit is the user's decision and requires their explicit approval.
G4_outcome_ceiling.also_forbidden: adopting 1.25x, 1.75x or any value other than 1.0x/1.5x, on any evidence produced here

effect_size_gate.applied_to: monthly PnL difference series (1.0x minus 1.5x) under the cap, per split; see G3.instrument_note for why per-trade returns are not used

fresh_forward.method: 3-asset concurrent bar-by-bar replay via replay_portfolio_concurrent_3asset_native_20260712._replay_concurrent; worlds built once per split from causal panels and replayed per config; no saved ledger is read as input
